name: Deniz Papağanı
scene: An Atlantic puffin stands in right-facing profile on a coastal rock against sweeping sea and sky bands.
notes: Redrawn from motif_puffin; fox and lighthouse sheets attached as style references. Target 31–41 panes. Generated and visually inspected, then regenerated once to remove bill crossings, eye connector and toe marks and restore a white exterior. Subject uses orange/amber exclusively; background uses blue/teal exclusively. Remaining concerns: subtle fill shading persists; a four-way shoulder junction and several same-colour neighbouring bird panes remain; tapered wing pieces and closely spaced bill-root junctions need review during tracing. Raster connected-component estimate is 53 coloured regions, above the requested pane target; same-colour merging may reduce this but the final count is not validated. Design sheet only, not audited puzzle geometry or finished glass artwork.
